derivation: Four lines. 'ld.lld: error: undefined symbol: helper(int)' is an lld line with no place: one error, file, line, and column null, code null, the message the text after 'ld.lld: error: '. The two lines that start with '>>> ' are lld's context (the source file named by the object, then the temporary object under the capture's workdir), so no diagnostic. 'clang++-20: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)' is a clang driver line with no place: one error, the message the text after 'clang++-20: error: '.

diagnostics.message: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
